communities.topOperationalFocus: Maintain staffing rhythm and protect schedule routines
communities.watchItem: Protect the current staffing rhythm so low volatility does not drift into avoidable rework.
communities.operationalConsequence: If routines loosen, today's contained variability can become tomorrow's avoidable escalation.
priorityActions: Maintain current staffing routines and avoid unnecessary schedule disruption.
Review early-warning signals before adding new operational complexity.
Focus recruiting attention on roles tied directly to current coverage fragility.
Use resident demand and family communication signals to anticipate avoidable escalations.
Close the day with one leadership read on what pressure carried forward.

top5Queue.item: Maintain staffing rhythm and protect schedule routines
Stabilize coverage on shifts with recurring open-shift or call-off pressure.
Review overtime and agency use as absorption signals, not just labor cost.
Protect leadership capacity from avoidable recovery work.
